discoveryHelp: Open nooboard on the other device, allow discovery, and connect to the same network. If it still does not appear, check local network permissions, firewall, and VPN settings, then refresh.
addressUnavailable: Unable to get local addresses. Try again later.
noAddress: No address available. Check your connection.
showCode: Enter this code on the other device
pairConsent: This device wants to share clipboards with you.
codeStatus: Expires in {{seconds, number}}s · {{count, number}} attempts left
codeStatus_one: Expires in {{seconds, number}}s · {{count, number}} attempt left
codeStatus_other: Expires in {{seconds, number}}s · {{count, number}} attempts left
approveElsewhere: Click “Allow pairing” on the other device.
currentConnectionAddressHelp: The other device’s IP and port for this connection. When it initiates the connection, the port may be temporary.
savedAddressHelp: A previously saved sync address that may be out of date.
unpairEffect: Stop sharing and automatic connection attempts, and remove this device’s saved information. Sharing again requires pairing again. Local text history will be kept.
pairAgainHelp: The other device ended pairing. Pair again to resume sharing.
remotePaused: Sync paused on the other device
notReceiving: The other device is not receiving
removeEffect: Remove this device’s saved information. Local text history will be kept.
unpairedNoticeBody: Sharing and automatic connection attempts have stopped. Remove this device’s saved information? Keeping it will not resume sharing.
